name: Drake London

background.fact: Born July 24, 2001 in Moorpark, California; he is a wide receiver for the Atlanta Falcons, drafted eighth overall in the 2022 NFL draft out of USC.

He attended Moorpark High School, playing football and basketball; as a senior he had 62 catches for 1,089 yards and 12 touchdowns in football and averaged 29.2 points and 11.9 rebounds in basketball.
He committed to USC to play both football and basketball, and in basketball as a freshman he played in three games.
At USC he was Pac-12 Offensive Player of the Year in 2021, then fractured his right ankle in the eighth game of that season and declared for the draft.
Listed at 6 ft 4 in, 215 lb, age 25, jersey 5, in his fifth NFL season.

scouts_read: London is active and has no injury label this week, so the question is production, not availability. He is the Falcons' clear first read with more than a quarter of the targets, but only one touchdown in nine games keeps his scoring flat, averaging 8.4 points. Kansas City brings pressure that has hurt Penix, and ESPN calls their secondary stingy, though Atlanta being a home underdog could mean more passing. I would expect 5 to 7 catches and a yardage line near 60 to 80 with a modest chance at a touchdown. The back to back fines are a side note and do not look like a suspension risk from the reports found.
